title: Malicious code in bundle-entry-points (npm)
description: The npm package 'bundle-entry-points' version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that executes automatically upon installation. It runs a postinstall script that sends a POST request with identifying information to an anonymous third-party URL, confirming the package installation to an external operator without user consent. The script also logs local system details such as hostname and working directory. This behavior constitutes unauthorized data exfiltration and remote confirmation of compromise.
